name: launcher
summary: A short command at the project root, so every kit command is `python3 kit COMMAND`, or `py kit COMMAND` on Windows. It runs the installed tool and nothing else.
tested: none: the tests install it, run commands through it and remove it, but no project has used it yet.
manual: Run python3 .engineering-kit/kit/tools/kit.py COMMAND from the project root.
